summary: US-Iran tensions escalated dramatically with mutual military strikes; the US struck Iran's Lamerd killing at least 21 civilians, while Iran fired missiles at two bases in Jordan and targeted IRGC mining forces on Lark Island. Trump warned of strong US response and is considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities. In Gaza, Israeli special forces conducted a targeted operation in western Gaza City amid intense drone activity and artillery, with IDF killing a Hamas supply commander in Zabara.
key_points: US missile strike on Iran's Lamerd killed at least 21 civilians including 7 children and 2 women, according to PressTV reports, representing a significant escalation in civilian casualties. (Source: @presstv/205025)
Iran fired missiles at two military bases in Jordan following US strikes on IRGC mining forces on Lark Island, marking direct cross-border military exchanges. (Source: @VahidOnline/78119)

Trump announced the US will respond forcefully to Iran attacks, warning he may 'smack' Iran, as the Armed Forces General Staff warned they will target US forces. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6658, @VahidOnline/78119)
Axios reported Trump is considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities to attack shipping. (Source: @VahidOnline/78120)

Israeli special forces conducted an operation in western Gaza City with intense drone activity and artillery coverage, reportedly attempting to capture the 'head of Shin Bet.' (Source: @amitsegal/64435, @rasedal3ado138e/387931)

Israeli drone strikes near Al-Katiba area west of Gaza City killed at least one person amid ongoing clashes, with Israeli forces conducting intensive strikes in western Gaza. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6663, @inon_yttach/9988)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated Israel will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas is disarmed, all tunnels destroyed, and weapons removed from the Strip. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88949)
A commercial vessel was attacked in the southern Strait of Hormuz near Oman coasts, with no casualties reported, amid heightened regional maritime tensions. (Source: @asafroz/52962)

sections.executive_summary: US-Iran military tensions reached their highest point with mutual strikes: the US struck Iran's Lamerd killing at least 21 civilians including 7 children, while Iran responded by firing missiles at two Jordanian bases and targeting IRGC positions on Lark Island. Trump is considering limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding naval attack capabilities, with reports of electronic jamming over the Persian Gulf. In Gaza, Israeli special forces conducted a high-profile operation in western Gaza City amid intense bombardment, with IDF killing a Hamas supply commander in Zabara area.

sections.threat_assessment: The direct US-Iran military exchange represents the most significant escalation since tensions began, with Iran's missile strikes on Jordanian bases demonstrating willingness to conduct cross-border operations. Trump's consideration of limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz targets Iran's most critical maritime chokepoint, where commercial shipping faces immediate threats. Iranian Air Defense Command's claim of 3,800+ defensive positions across diverse terrain complicates potential US strikes. Electronic warfare activity over the Persian Gulf suggests either pre-strike preparation or deterrence signaling, while Iran's stated policy of targeting US forces using regional airspace puts allied nations in difficult positions.
sections.regional_response: Iraq's deployment of air defenses toward Iran from Maysan province indicates Baghdad is taking precautions but avoiding direct alignment with either side. The attack on a commercial vessel near Oman in the southern Strait of Hormuz demonstrates the immediate economic stakes of continued escalation. Greek-Israeli defense cooperation deepening through a major security agreement suggests Israel is building allied partnerships to counter regional threats. Over 200 former Israeli officials' condemnation of West Bank settler violence highlights domestic political fractures that could affect wartime decision-making.
sections.intelligence_notes: The disclosure of a US operation against IRGC 'mining forces' on Lark Island suggests a specific counter-proliferation mission targeting Iran's attempts to place naval mines in strategic waterways. Iran's Central Bank reporting 122,000+ cyberattacks in one year indicates significant digital warfare dimension to the conflict. The Israeli special forces operation in western Gaza City near the ICRC headquarters represents a high-risk tactical choice with potential diplomatic implications. Electronic jamming over the Persian Gulf may indicate US or allied preparation for electronic warfare operations or defensive measures against Iranian capabilities.
